title: Deploying AI for Signal Processing education: Selected challenges and intriguing opportunities

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical discussion and mathematical formulation proposing the use of group fairness measures (statistical parity and equal opportunity) to evaluate and correct systemic underrepresentation of women in AI-powered academic advising tools.

Conceptual evaluation defining statistical parity and equal opportunity metrics to identify and mitigate biases against underrepresented minority students caused by historical skewness in educational training data.
